title: Get Watched Videos by Your Friends
summary: Given n people with unique ids from 0 to n-1, and arrays for watched videos and friends, return the list of videos at a specified level, ordered by frequency and alphabetically for ties, based on the videos watched by people with a shortest path of exactly that level to the specified person.
statement: Given n people with unique ids from 0 to n-1, and arrays for watched videos and friends, return the list of videos at a specified level, ordered by frequency and alphabetically for ties, based on the videos watched by people with a shortest path of exactly that level to the specified person.
constraints: There are 1 through 100 people; friendship is undirected and every person is reachable from every other.
Collect videos watched by friends at exactly the requested shortest-path level, including repeated titles.
Sort titles by increasing frequency, breaking ties alphabetically.
hints: Breadth-first layers equal shortest friendship distance.
Expand a frontier while permanently marking every reached person.
After level expansions, count only that frontier’s titles and sort by (frequency,title).
A visited set prevents cycles and guarantees the frontier contains exactly the requested shortest-distance layer.
editorial: A visited set prevents cycles and guarantees the frontier contains exactly the requested shortest-distance layer.

tests.explanation: Level one contains people one and two. B and C each occur once, so alphabetical order gives B then C.
Only person two is exactly two edges away, so the answer is a.
